en.title: APEC Business Travel Card: a guide to easier ASEAN business travel
en.standfirst: How executives can use the APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) to bypass visa queues and fast-track short-term business travel across ASEAN.
en.metaDescription: How executives can use the APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) to bypass visa queues and fast-track short-term business travel across ASEAN economies.
en.body:
For executives making frequent trips across the region, the **APEC Business Travel Card** can simplify short-term business travel. Taiwan takes part in APEC as Chinese Taipei and is an ABTC participant, so cardholders based in Taiwan can use the scheme for qualifying visits to participating ASEAN economies.

The **ABTC ASEAN** arrangements cover several important Southeast Asian destinations. Eligible travellers can use pre-clearance and dedicated immigration lanes, and the Virtual ABTC allows cardholders of economies that have adopted it to present the card through a smartphone application.

For businesses researching a **fast-track ASEAN business visa**, the important distinction is that the ABTC facilitates qualifying business visits. It does not replace permission for long-term employment or residence.

## What is the ABTC

The ABTC allows eligible business travellers to apply through their home economy for pre-clearance to participating APEC economies.

Where the destination has granted pre-clearance, the card can serve as the entry authority for a qualifying short-term business visit without a separate visa application. It also provides access to designated fast-track immigration lanes at major participating airports. [APEC: Business Travel Card overview](https://www.apec.org/what-we-do/committee-on-trade-and-investment/business-mobility-group/apec-business-travel-card-abtc-and-virtual-abtc)

These benefits concern immigration processing. They do not remove customs declarations, baggage inspections or quarantine and biosecurity requirements.

The card should also be used within its permitted business purposes, rather than treated as authority to take up local employment.

## Participating ASEAN economies

The participating ASEAN economies covered in this guide are:

- Brunei Darussalam
- Indonesia
- Malaysia
- The Philippines
- Singapore
- Thailand
- Vietnam

Pre-clearance is granted separately by each economy. Approval by the applicant's home economy does not mean that every destination has already approved entry.

Permitted visits are generally up to 60 or 90 days, depending on the economy. Confirm the destination's specific permitted stay and entry conditions before booking; the card's overall validity is different from the length of each visit.

## The Virtual ABTC

The Virtual ABTC is a digital version of the card, accessible through a cardholder's smart device. Economies adopt it progressively, so check whether your home economy issues a virtual card, a physical card or both.

After home-economy approval, destination pre-clearances appear progressively as participating economies approve them. Check that the relevant clearance appears before relying on the card for travel.

Keep the card's passport details current. If your passport is renewed, update the card record through your home economy's issuing authority before travelling.

Before departure, check that you can access the application or carry the physical card, and that you can present the required information at the border.

## Application and eligibility

Applicants must satisfy their home economy's eligibility requirements and provide evidence supporting their genuine business travel.

Prepare identity documents and evidence of trade or investment activity, then apply through the home economy's issuing authority. Monitor the application as individual economies assess pre-clearance.

The ABTC is valid for five years from issue. Processing across participating economies varies, so avoid treating approval for every destination as available by a guaranteed date.

For frequent regional business travellers, the value lies in preparing once and maintaining accurate clearance and passport information for each trip.

zh.title: APEC商務旅行卡：簡化東協商務旅行指南
zh.standfirst: 了解企業主管如何運用APEC商務旅行卡（ABTC）免除簽證排隊，加速往返東協各國的短期商務旅行。
zh.metaDescription: 了解企業主管如何運用APEC商務旅行卡（ABTC）免除簽證排隊，加速前往參與東協經濟體的短期商務旅行。
zh.body:
對於經常往返區域各地的企業主管而言，**APEC商務旅行卡（APEC Business Travel Card）**可簡化短期商務旅行。台灣以「中華台北」（Chinese Taipei）名義參與APEC，並為ABTC參與經濟體，因此在台灣持卡的旅客可利用此機制前往參與的東協經濟體，進行符合資格的商務訪問。

**ABTC東協**安排涵蓋多個重要的東南亞目的地。符合資格的旅客可使用預先通關及專用移民通道；已採用虛擬ABTC的經濟體，其持卡人亦可透過智慧型手機應用程式出示卡片。

對於正在研究**東協快速商務簽證**的企業而言，重要的區別在於ABTC僅便利符合資格的商務訪問，並不能取代長期工作或居留的許可。

## 什麼是ABTC

ABTC讓符合資格的商務旅客透過所屬經濟體提出申請，取得前往參與APEC經濟體的預先通關。

目的地經濟體核准預先通關後，持卡人進行符合資格的短期商務訪問時，該卡即可作為入境許可，無需另行申請簽證。持卡人亦可在主要參與機場使用指定的快速移民通道。[APEC：商務旅行卡概覽](https://www.apec.org/what-we-do/committee-on-trade-and-investment/business-mobility-group/apec-business-travel-card-abtc-and-virtual-abtc)

這些便利僅涉及移民通關程序，並不免除海關申報、行李檢查或檢疫與生物安全要求。

持卡人亦應在獲准的商務目的範圍內使用該卡，而非將其視為在當地就業的許可。

## 參與的東協經濟體

本指南涵蓋的參與東協經濟體如下：

- 汶萊
- 印尼
- 馬來西亞
- 菲律賓
- 新加坡
- 泰國
- 越南

預先通關由各經濟體分別核准。申請人所屬經濟體核發卡片，並不代表每個目的地都已核准入境。

獲准的訪問期限一般最長為60天或90天，視經濟體而定。訂票前請確認目的地的具體准許停留期限及入境條件；卡片的整體有效期與每次訪問的停留期限是兩回事。

## 虛擬ABTC

虛擬ABTC（Virtual ABTC）是卡片的數位版本，可透過持卡人的智慧裝置使用。各經濟體逐步採用，請確認所屬經濟體核發的是虛擬卡、實體卡或兩者皆有。

所屬經濟體核准後，各目的地的預先通關會隨參與經濟體陸續核准而逐步顯示。在依賴該卡出行前，請確認相關通關已經顯示。

請保持卡片上的護照資料為最新。護照換發後，出行前應透過所屬經濟體的核發機關更新卡片紀錄。

出發前，請確認您能開啟應用程式或攜帶實體卡，並能在邊境出示所需資料。

## 申請與資格

申請人必須符合所屬經濟體的資格要求，並提供證明文件支持其真實的商務旅行需求。

準備身分文件及貿易或投資活動的證明，再透過所屬經濟體的核發機關提出申請。各經濟體逐一評估預先通關期間，請持續追蹤申請進度。

ABTC自核發日起有效期為五年。各參與經濟體的處理時間不一，因此不應假設所有目的地的核准會在保證的日期前完成。

對經常往返區域的商務旅客而言，其價值在於一次準備妥當，並為每次行程維持準確的通關與護照資料。
